dn24:1.1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Mallesu viharati. Anupiyaṃ nāma Mallānaṃ nigamo.
dn24:1.1.3: Atha kho Bhagavā pubbaṇha-samayaṃ nivāsetvā patta-cīvaram ādāya Anupiyaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
dn24:1.1.6: yan nūnāhaṃ yena Bhaggava-gottassa paribbājakassa ārāmo yena Bhaggavagotto paribbājako ten' upasaṃkameyyan ti.'
dn24:1.2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā yena Bhaggava-gottassa paribbājakassa ārāmo yena Bhaggava-gotto paribbājako ten' upasaṃkami. 1.
dn24:1.2.2: Atha kho Bhaggava-gotto paribbājako Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn24:1.2.5: cirassaṃ kho bhante Bhagavā imaṃ pariyāyam akāsi yadidaṃ idh' āgamanāya.
dn24:1.2.6: Nisīdatu bhante Bhagavā, idam āsanaṃ paññattan ti.'
dn24:1.2.8: Bhaggava-gotto pi kho paribbājako aññatara nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
dn24:1.2.9: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Bhaggava-gotto paribbājako Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn24:1.2.10: ‘Purimāni bhante divasāni purimatarāni Sunakkhatto Licchavi-putto yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā maṃ etad avoca:
dn24:1.2.12: Na dānāhaṃ Bhaggava Bhagavantaṃ uddissa viharāmīti.'
dn24:1.2.13: Kacc' etaṃ bhante tath' eva yathā Sunakkhatto Licchavi-putto avacāti?'
dn24:1.2.14: ‘Tath' eva kho etaṃ Bhaggava yathā Sunakkhatto Licchavi-putto avaca.' 3.
dn24:1.3.1: Purimāni Bhaggava divasāni purimatarāni Sunakkhatto Licchavi-putto yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṃkami. Upasaṃkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi, ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Bhaggava Sunakkhatto Licchavi-putto maṃ etad avoca:
dn24:1.3.3: na dānāhaṃ bhante Bhagavantaṃ uddissa viharissāmīti.'
dn24:1.3.4: Evaṃ vutte ahaṃ Bhaggava Sunakkhattaṃ Licchavi-puttaṃ etad avocaṃ:
dn24:1.3.6: Ehi tvaṃ Sunakkhatta, mamaṃ uddissa viharāhīti?
dn24:1.3.11: ‘Iti kira Sunakkhatta n' evāhan taṃ vadāmi --
dn24:1.3.12: Ehi tvaṃ Sunakkhatta mamaṃ uddissa viharāhīti;
dn24:1.3.13: na pi kira maṃ tvaṃ vadesi --
dn24:1.3.15: Evaṃ sante mogha-purisa ko santo kaṃ paccācikkhasi?
dn24:1.3.16: Passa mogha-purisa yāvañ ca te idaṃ aparaddhan ti.' 4.
dn24:1.4.1: ‘Na hi pana me bhante Bhagavā uttari-manussadhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ karotīti.'
dn24:1.4.3: Ehi tvaṃ Sunakkhatta, mamaṃ uddissa viharāhi, ahan te uttarimanussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ karissāmīti?'
dn24:1.4.6: Ahaṃ bhante Bhagavantaṃ uddissa viharissāmi, Bhagavā me uttari-manussadhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ karissatīti?'
dn24:1.4.9: Ehi tvaṃ Sunakkhatta mamaṃ uddissa viharāhi, ahan te uttarimanussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ karissāmīti;
dn24:1.4.10: na pi kira maṃ tvaṃ vadesi --
dn24:1.4.11: Ahaṃ bhante Bhagavantaṃ uddissa viharissāmi, Bhagavā me uttari-manussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ karissatīti.
dn24:1.4.12: Evaṃ sante mogha-purisa ko santo kaṃ paccācikkhasi?
dn24:1.4.14: Kate vā uttari-manussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriye akate vā uttari-manussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriye, yass' atthāya mayā dhammo desito so niyyāti takkarassa sammādukkha-kkhayāyāti?'
dn24:1.4.15: ‘Kate vā bhante uttari-manussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriye akate vā uttari-manussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriye, yass' atthāya Bhagavatā dhammo desito so niyyāti takkarassa sammā-dukkha-kkhayāyāti.'
dn24:1.4.16: ‘Iti kira Sunakkhatta kate vā uttari-manussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriye akate vā uttari-manussa-dhammā iddhipāṭihāriye, yass' atthāya mayā dhammo desito so niyyāti takkarassa sammā-dukkha-kkhayāya.
dn24:1.4.17: Tatra Sunakkhatta kiṃ uttari-manussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ kataṃ karissati?
dn24:1.4.18: Passa mogha-purisa yāvañ ca te idaṃ aparaddhan ti.' 5.
dn24:1.5.1: ‘Na hi pana me bhante Bhagavā aggaññaṃ paññā petīti. '
dn24:1.5.3: Ehi tvaṃ Sunakkhatta mamaṃ uddissa viharāhi, ahaṃ te aggaññaṃ paññāpessāmīti?'
dn24:1.5.6: Ahaṃ bhante Bhagavantaṃ uddissa viharissāmi, Bhagavā me aggaññaṃ paññāpessatīti?'
dn24:1.5.9: Ehi tvaṃ Sunakkhatta mamaṃ uddissa viharāhi, ahan te aggaññaṃ paññāpessāmīti;
dn24:1.5.10: na pi kira maṃ tvaṃ vadesi --
dn24:1.5.11: Ahaṃ bhante Bhagavantaṃ uddissa viharissāmi, Bhagavā me aggaññaṃ paññāpessatīti.
dn24:1.5.12: Evaṃ sante mogha-purisa ko santo kaṃ paccācikkhasi?
dn24:1.5.14: Paññatte vā aggaññe apaññatte vā aggaññe, yass' atthāya mayā dhammo desito so niyyāti takkarassa sammā-dukkha-kkhayāyāti?'
dn24:1.5.15: ‘Paññatte vā bhante aggaññe apaññatte vā aggaññe, yass' atthāya Bhagavatā dhammo desito so niyyāti takkarassa sammā-dukkha-kkhayāyāti.'
dn24:1.5.16: ‘Iti kira Sunakkhatta paññatte vā aggaññe apaññatte vā aggaññe yass' atthāya mayā dhammo desito so niyyāti takkarassa sammā-dukkha-kkhayāya.
dn24:1.5.17: Tatra Sunakkhatta kiṃ paññattaṃ aggaññaṃ karissati?
dn24:1.5.18: Passa mogha-purisa yāvañ ca te idaṃ aparaddhaṃ. 6.
dn24:1.6.1: ‘Aneka-pariyāyena kho te Sunakkhatta mama vaṇṇo bhāsito Vajji-gāme --
dn24:1.6.2: Iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ SammāSambuddho vijjā-caraṇa-sampanno sugato loka-vidū anuttaro purisa-damma-sārathi satthā deva-manussānaṃ Buddho Bhagavā ti.
dn24:1.6.3: Iti kho te Sunakkhatta aneka-pariyāyena mama vaṇṇo bhāsito Vajji-gāme.
dn24:1.6.4: ‘Aneka-pariyāyena kho te Sunakkhatta Dhammassa vaṇṇo bhāsito Vajji-gāme --
dn24:1.6.5: Svākkhāto Bhagavatā Dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehi-passiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti.
dn24:1.6.6: Iti kho te Sunakkhatta aneka-pariyāyena Dhammassa vaṇṇo bhāsito Vajji-gāme. ‘
dn24:1.6.7: Aneka -pariyāyena kho te Sunakkhatta Saṃghassa vaṇṇo bhāsito Vajji-gāme --
dn24:1.6.8: Supaṭipanno Bhagavato sāvaka-saṃgho, uju-paṭipanno Bhagavato sāvaka-saṃgho, ñāya-paṭipanno Bhagavato sāvaka-saṃgho, sāmīci-paṭipanno Bhagavato sāvaka-saṃgho, yadidaṃ cattāri purisayugāni aṭṭha-purisa-puggalā, esa Bhagavato sāvaka-saṃgho āhuṇeyyo pāhuṇeyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjali-karaṇīyo anuttaraṃ puñña-kkhettaṃ lokassāti.
dn24:1.6.9: Iti kho te Sunakkhatta aneka-pariyāyena Saṃghassa vaṇṇo bhāsito Vajji-gāme.
dn24:1.6.10: ‘Ārocayāmi kho te Sunakkhatta, paṭivedayāmi kho te Sunakkhatta,
dn24:1.6.11: bhavissanti kho te Sunakkhatta vattāro -No visahi Sunakkhatto Licchavi-putto Samaṇe Gotame brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ, so avisahanto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy' āvatto ti.
dn24:1.6.12: Iti kho te Sunakkhatta bhavissanti vattāro ti.'
dn24:1.6.13: Evam pi kho Bhaggava Sunakkhatto Licchavi-putto mayā vuccamāno apakkam' eva imasmā dhamma-vinayā yathā taṃ apāyiko nerayiko. 7.
dn24:1.7.1: Ekam idāhaṃ Bhaggava samayaṃ Bumūsu viharāmi, Uttarakā nāma Bumūnaṃ nigamo.
dn24:1.7.2: Atha kho 'haṃ Bhaggava pubbaṇha-samayaṃ nivāsetvā patta-cīvaram ādāya Sunakkhattena Licchavi-puttena pacchā-samaṇena Uttarakaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ.
dn24:1.7.3: Tena kho pana samayena acelo Korakkhattiyo kukkuravatiko catukuṇḍiko chamānikkiṇṇaṃ bhakkhasaṃ mukhen' eva khādati mukhen' eva bhuñjati.
dn24:1.7.4: Addasā kho Bhaggava Sunakkhatto Licchavi-putto acelaṃ Korakkhattiyaṃ kukkuravatikaṃ catukuṇḍikaṃ chamā- nikkiṇṇaṃ bhakkhasaṃ mukhen' eva khādantaṃ mukhen' eva bhuñjantaṃ.
dn24:1.7.6: ‘Sādhu-rūpo vata bho arahaṃ samaṇo catukuṇḍiko chamānikkiṇṇaṃ bhakkhasaṃ mukhen' eva khādati mukhen' eva bhuñjatīti.'
dn24:1.7.7: Atha kho ahaṃ Bhaggava Sunakkhattassa Licchaviputtassa cetasā ceto-parivitakkam aññāya Sunakkhat taṃ Licchavi-puttaṃ etad avocaṃ:
dn24:1.7.9: ‘Kiṃ pana maṃ bhante Bhagavā evam āha --
dn24:1.7.10: Tvam pi nāma mogha-purisa Sakya-puttiyo paṭijānissasīti?'
dn24:1.7.11: ‘Na nu te Sunakkhatta imaṃ acelaṃ Korakkhattiyaṃ kukkuravatikaṃ catukuṇḍikaṃ chamā-nikkiṇṇaṃ bhakkhasaṃ mukhen' eva khādantaṃ mukhen' eva bhuñjantaṃ disvāna etad ahosi --
dn24:1.7.12: Sādhu-rūpo vata bho arahaṃ samaṇo catukuṇḍiko chamā-nikkiṇṇaṃ bhakkhasaṃ mukhen' eva khādati mukhen' eva bhuñjati?'
dn24:1.7.14: Kim pana bhante Bhagavā arahattassa maccharāyatīti?'
dn24:1.7.16: Api ca tuyh' ev' etaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhi-gataṃ upapannaṃ, taṃ pajaha,
dn24:1.7.17: mā te ahosi dīgha-rattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya.
dn24:1.7.18: Yaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Sunakkhatta maññasi acelaṃ Korakkhattiyaṃ -- Sādhu-rūpo arahaṃ samaṇo ti, so sattama-divasaṃ alasakena kālaṃ karissati,
dn24:1.7.19: kālakato ca Kālakañjā nāma asurā sabba-nihīno asura-kāyo tatra upapajjissati,
dn24:1.7.20: kālakatañ ca naṃ bīraṇa-tthambhake susāne chaḍḍessanti.
dn24:1.7.21: Ākaṅkhamāno ca tvaṃ Sunakkhatta acelaṃ Korakkhattiyaṃ upasaṃkamitvā puccheyyāsi --
dn24:1.7.22: Jānāsi āvuso Korakkhattiya attano gatiṃ ti?
dn24:1.7.23: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Sunakkhatta vijjati , yan te acelo Korakkhattiyo vyākarissati --
dn24:1.7.25: Kālakañjā nāma asurā sabba-nihīno asura-kāyo tatr' amhi upapanno ti.' 8.
dn24:1.8.1: Atha kho Bhaggava Sunakkhatto Licchavi-putto yena acelo Korakkhattiyo ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā acelaṃ Korakkhattiyaṃ etad avoca:
dn24:1.8.3: Acelo Korakkhattiyo sattama-divasaṃ alasakena kālaṃ karissati,
dn24:1.8.4: kālakato ca Kālakañjā nāmā asurā sabba-nihīno asura-kāyo tatra upapajjissati,
dn24:1.8.5: kālakatañ ca naṃ bīraṇa-tthambhake susāne chaḍḍessantīti.
dn24:1.8.6: Yena tvaṃ āvuso Korakkhattiya mattaṃ mattaṃ ca bhattaṃ bhuñjeyyāsi, mattaṃ mattaṃ ca pānīyaṃ piveyyāsi,
dn24:1.8.7: yathā Samaṇassa Gotamassa micchā assa vacanan ti.'
dn24:1.8.8: Atha kho Bhaggava Sunakkhatto eka-dvīhikāya sattarattindivāni gaṇesi yathā taṃ Tathāgatassa asaddahamāno.
dn24:1.8.9: Atha kho Bhaggava acelo Korakkhattiyo sattama-divasaṃ alasakena kālam akāsi,
dn24:1.8.10: kālakato Kālakañjā nāma asurā sabba-nihīno asura-kāyo tatra upapajji,
dn24:1.8.11: kālakatañ ca taṃ bīraṇa-tthambhake susāne chaḍḍesuṃ. 9.
dn24:1.9.2: Acelo Korakkhattiyo alasakena kālakato bīraṇa-tthambhake susāne chaḍḍito ti.
dn24:1.9.3: Atha kho Bhaggava Sunakkhatto Licchaviputto yena bīraṇa-tthambhakaṃ susānaṃ yena acelo Korakkhattiyo ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā acelaṃ Korakkhattiyaṃ tikkhattuṃ pāṇinā ākoṭesi --
dn24:1.9.5: Atha kho Bhaggava acelo Korakkhattiyo pāṇinā piṭṭhiṃ paripuñjanto vuṭṭhāsi --
dn24:1.9.7: Kālakañjā nāma asurā sabba-nihīno asura-kāyo tatr' amhi upapanno ti' vatvā tatth' eva uttāno papati. 10.
dn24:1.10.1: Atha kho Bhaggava Sunakkhatto Licchavi-putto yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho ahaṃ Bhaggava Sunakkhattaṃ Licchavi-puttaṃ etad avocaṃ:
dn24:1.10.3: Yath' eva te ahaṃ acelaṃ Korakkhattiyaṃ ārabbha vyākāsiṃ, tath' eva taṃ vipākaṃ aññathā vā ti?'
dn24:1.10.4: ‘Yath' eva me bhante Bhagavā acelaṃ Korakkhattiyaṃ ārabbha vyākāsi, tath' eva taṃ vipākaṃ no aññathā ti.'
dn24:1.10.6: Yadi evaṃ sante kataṃ vā hoti uttari-manussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ akataṃ vā ti?'
dn24:1.10.7: ‘Addhā kho bhante evaṃ sante kataṃ hoti uttarimanussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ no akatan ti.'
dn24:1.10.8: ‘Evam pi kho maṃ tvaṃ mogha-purisa uttari-manussadhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ karontaṃ evaṃ vadesi --
dn24:1.10.9: Na hi pana me bhante Bhagavā uttari-manussa-dhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ karotīti.
dn24:1.10.10: Passa mogha-purisa yāvañ ca te idaṃ aparaddhan ti.'
dn24:1.10.11: Evam pi kho Bhaggava Sunakkhatto Licchavi-putto mayā vuccamāno apakkam' eva imasmā dhamma-vinayā, yathā taṃ āpāyiko nerayiko. 11.
dn24:1.11.1: Ekam idāhaṃ Bhaggava samayaṃ Vesāliyaṃ viharāmi Mahā-vane kūṭāgāra-sālāyaṃ.
dn24:1.11.2: Tena kho pana samayena acelo Kandaramasuko Vesāliyaṃ paṭivasati lābhagga-ppatto c' eva yasagga-ppatto ca Vajji-gāme.
dn24:1.11.3: Tassa satta vatta-padāni samattāni samādinnāni honti --
dn24:1.11.4: ‘Yāvajīvaṃ acelako assaṃ, na vatthaṃ paridaheyyaṃ: yāvajīvaṃ brahmacārī assaṃ, na methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭiseveyyaṃ: yāva-jīvaṃ surā-maṃsen' eva yāpeyyaṃ, na odana-kummāsaṃ bhuñjeyyaṃ:
dn24:1.11.5: puratthimena Vesāliyaṃ Udenaṃ nāma cetiyaṃ taṃ nātikkameyyaṃ: dakkhiṇena Vesāliyaṃ Gotamakaṃ nāma cetiyaṃ taṃ nātikkameyyaṃ: pacchimena Vesāliyaṃ Sattambaṃ nāma cetiyaṃ taṃ nātikkameyyaṃ: uttarena Vesāliyaṃ Bahuputtaṃ nāma cetiyaṃ taṃ nātikkameyyan ti.'
dn24:1.11.6: So imesaṃ sattannaṃ vatta-padānaṃ samādāna -hetu lābhagga-ppatto c' eva yasagga-ppatto ca Vajji-gāme. 12.
dn24:1.12.1: Atha kho Bhaggava Sunakkhatto Licchavi-putto yena acelo Kandaramasuko ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā acelaṃ Kandaramasukaṃ pañhaṃ apucchi.
dn24:1.12.2: Tassa acelo Kandaramasuko pañhaṃ puṭṭho na sampāyāsi,
dn24:1.12.3: asampāyanto kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātvākāsi.
dn24:1.12.4: Atha kho Bhaggava Sunakkhattassa Licchavi-puttassa etad ahosi --
dn24:1.12.6: mā vata no ahosi dīgha-rattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyāti.' 13.
dn24:1.13.1: Atha kho Bhaggava Sunakkhatto Licchavi-putto yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṃkami upasaṃkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi, ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho ahaṃ Bhaggava Sunakkhattaṃ Licchavi-puttaṃ etad avocaṃ:
dn24:1.13.3: ‘Kiṃ pana maṃ bhante Bhagavā evam āha --
dn24:1.13.4: Tvam pi nāma mogha-purisa Sakya-puttiyo paṭijānissasīti?'
dn24:1.13.5: ‘Nanu tvaṃ Sunakkhatta acelaṃ Kandaramasukaṃ upasaṃkamitvā pañhaṃ apucchi?
dn24:1.13.6: Tassa te acelo Kandaramasuko pañhaṃ puṭṭho na sampāyāsi,
dn24:1.13.7: asampāyanto kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātvākāsi.
dn24:1.13.9: Sādhu-rūpaṃ vata bho arahantaṃ samaṇaṃ āsādimhase,
dn24:1.13.10: mā vata no ahosi dīgha-rattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyāti.'
dn24:1.13.12: Kim pana bhante Bhagavā arahattassa maccharāyatīti?'
dn24:1.13.13: ‘Na kho p' ahaṃ mogha-purisa arahattassa maccharāyāmi.
dn24:1.13.14: Api ca tuyh' ev' etaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhi-gataṃ uppannaṃ, taṃ pajaha,
dn24:1.13.15: mā te ahosi dīgha-rattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya.
dn24:1.13.16: Yaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Sunakkhatta maññasi acelaṃ Kandaramasukaṃ --
dn24:1.13.17: Sādhu-rūpo arahaṃ samaṇo ti, so na cirass' eva parihito sānucariyo vicaranto odana-kummāsaṃ bhuñjamāno sabbān' eva Vesāliyāni cetiyāni samatikkamitvā yasā nikkiṇṇo kālaṃ karissatīti.'
dn24:1.13.18: Atha kho Bhaggava acelo Kandaramasuko na cirass' eva parihito sānucariyo vicaranto odana-kummāsaṃ bhuñjamāno sabbān' eva Vesāliyāni cetiyāni samatikkamitvā yasā nikkiṇṇo kālam akāsi. 14.
dn24:1.14.2: Acelo kira Kandaramasuko parihito sānucariyo vicaranto odana-kummāsaṃ bhuñjamāno sabbān' eva Vesāliyāni cetiyāni samatikkamitvā yasā nikkiṇṇo kālaṃ karoti.
dn24:1.14.3: Atha kho Bhaggava Sunakkhatto yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṃkami , upasaṃkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi, ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho ahaṃ Bhaggava Sunakkhattaṃ Licchaviputtaṃ etad avocaṃ:
dn24:1.14.5: Yath' eva te ahaṃ acelaṃ Kandaramasukaṃ ārabbha vyākāsiṃ, tath' eva taṃ vipākaṃ aññathā vā ti?'
dn24:1.14.6: ‘Yath' eva me bhante Bhagavā acelaṃ Kandaramasukaṃ ārabbha vyākāsi, tath' eva taṃ vipākaṃ no aññathā ti.'
dn24:1.14.8: Yadi evaṃ sante kataṃ vā hoti uttari-manussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ, akataṃ vā ti?'
dn24:1.14.9: ‘Addhā kho bhante evaṃ sante kataṃ hoti uttarimanussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ, no akatan ti.'
dn24:1.14.10: ‘Evam pi kho maṃ tvaṃ mogha-purisa uttari-manussadhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ karontaṃ evaṃ vadesi --
dn24:1.14.11: Na hi pana me bhante Bhagavā uttari-manussa-dhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ karotīti.
dn24:1.14.12: Passa mogha-purisa yāvañ ca te idaṃ aparaddhan ti.'
dn24:1.14.13: Evam pi kho Bhaggava Sunakkhatto Licchavi-putto mayā vuccamāno apakkam' eva imasmā dhamma-vinayā, yathā taṃ āpāyiko nerayiko. 15.
dn24:1.15.1: Ekam idāhaṃ Bhaggava samayaṃ tatth' eva Vesāliyaṃ viharāmi Mahā-vane kūṭāgāra-sālāyaṃ.
dn24:1.15.2: Tena kho pana samayena acelo Pāṭika-putto Vesāliyaṃ paṭivasati lābhagga-ppatto c' eva yasagga-ppatto ca Vajji-gāme.
dn24:1.15.3: So Vesāliyaṃ parisati evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati:
dn24:1.15.4: ‘Samaṇo pi Gotamo ñāṇa-vādo, aham pi ñāṇa-vādo,
dn24:1.15.5: ñāṇa-vādo kho pana ñāṇa-vādena arahati uttari-manussadhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ dassetuṃ.
dn24:1.15.6: Samaṇo Gotamo upaḍḍha-pathaṃ āgaccheyya, ahaṃ ca upaḍḍha-pathaṃ gaccheyyaṃ.
dn24:1.15.7: Te tattha ubho uttari-manussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ kareyyāma.
dn24:1.15.8: Ekaṃ ce Samaṇo Gotamo uttari-manussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ karissati, dvāhaṃ karissāmi.
dn24:1.15.9: Dve ce Samaṇo Gotamo uttarimanussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyāni karissati, cattārāhaṃ karissāmi.
dn24:1.15.10: Cattāri ce Samaṇo Gotamo uttari-manussadhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyāni karissati, aṭṭhāhaṃ karissāmi.
dn24:1.15.11: Iti yāvatakaṃ yāvatakaṃ Samaṇo Gotamo uttari-manussadhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ karissati, tad-diguṇaṃ taddiguṇāhaṃ karissāmīti.' 16.
dn24:1.16.1: Atha kho Bhaggava Sunakkhatto Licchavi-putto yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Bhaggava Sunakkhatto Licchavi-putto maṃ etad avoca:
dn24:1.16.2: ‘Acelo bhante Pāṭika-putto Vesāliyaṃ paṭivasatilābhaggappatto c' eva yasagga-ppatto ca Vajji-gāme.
dn24:1.16.3: So Vesāliyaṃ parisati evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati --
dn24:1.16.4: Samaṇo pi Gotamo ñāṇavādo, aham pi ñāṇa-vādo,
dn24:1.16.5: ñāṇa-vādo kho pana ñāṇa-vādena arahati uttari-manussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ dassetuṃ.
dn24:1.16.6: Samaṇo ca Gotamo upaḍḍha-pathaṃ āgaccheyya, aham pi upaḍḍha-pathaṃ gaccheyyaṃ.
dn24:1.16.7: Te tattha ubho uttari-manussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ kareyyāma.
dn24:1.16.11: manussa-dhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ karissati . . . pe . . . tad-diguṇaṃ taddiguṇāhaṃ karissāmīti.'
dn24:1.16.12: Evaṃ vutte ahaṃ Bhaggava Sunakkhattaṃ Licchaviputtaṃ etad avocaṃ:
dn24:1.16.13: ‘Abhabbo kho Sunakkhatta acelo Pāṭika-putto taṃ vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā mama sammukhī-bhāvaṃ āgantuṃ.
dn24:1.16.15: Ahaṃ taṃ vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhim appaṭinissajjitvā Samaṇassa Gotamassa sammukhī-bhāvaṃ gaccheyyan ti, -- muddhā pi tassa vipateyyāti.' 17.
dn24:1.17.1: ‘Rakkhat' etaṃ bhante Bhagavā vācaṃ, rakkhat' etaṃ Sugato vācan ti.'
dn24:1.17.2: ‘Kiṃ pana maṃ tvaṃ Sunakkhatta evaṃ vadesi --
dn24:1.17.3: Rakkhat' etaṃ bhante Bhagavā vācaṃ, rakkhat' etaṃ Sugato vācan ti?'
dn24:1.17.4: ‘Bhagavatā c' assa bhante esā vācā ekaṃsena ovāditā: --
dn24:1.17.5: Abhabbo acelo Pāṭika-putto taṃ vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā mama sammukhī-bhāvaṃ āgantuṃ:
dn24:1.17.7: Ahaṃ taṃ vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā Samaṇassa Gotamassa sammukhī-bhāvam gaccheyyan ti -- muddhā pi tassa vipateyyāti.
dn24:1.17.8: Acelo ca bhante Pāṭika-putto virūpa-rūpena Bhagavato sammukhībhāvaṃ āgaccheyya, tad assa Bhagavato musā ti.' 18.
dn24:1.18.1: ‘Api nu Sunakkhatta Tathāgato taṃ vācaṃ bhāseyya yā sā vācā dvaya-gāminī ti?'
dn24:1.18.2: ‘Kiṃ pana bhante Bhagavatā acelo Pāṭika-putto cetasā ceto paricca vidito --
dn24:1.18.3: Abhabbo acelo Pāṭika-putto taṃ vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā mama sammukhī-bhāvaṃ āgantuṃ,
dn24:1.18.5: Ahaṃ taṃ vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā Samaṇassa Gotamassa sammukhī-bhāvam gaccheyyan ti, muddhā pi tassa vipateyyāti?
dn24:1.18.6: Udāhu devatā Tathāgatassa etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ
dn24:1.18.7: -Abhabbo bhante acelo Pāṭika-putto taṃ vācaṃ appahāya . . .
dn24:1.18.10: ‘Cetasā ceto paricca vidito c' eva Sunakkhatta acelo Pāṭika-putto --
dn24:1.18.11: Abhabbo acelo Pāṭika-putto taṃ vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya . . . pe . . . muddhā pi tassa vipateyyāti, devatā pi mama
dn24:1.18.15: "Abhabbo bhante acelo Pāṭika-putto taṃ vācaṃ appahāya . . .
dn24:1.18.18: Ajito pi nāma Licchavīnaṃ senāpati adhunā kāla-kato Tāvatiṃsakāyaṃ upapanno.
dn24:1.18.19: So pi maṃ upasaṃkamitvā evam ārocesi:
dn24:1.18.22: mam pi bhante acelo Pāṭika-putto vyākāsi Vajji-gāme --
dn24:1.18.23: Ajito Licchavīnaṃ senāpati mahā-nirayaṃ upapanno ti.
dn24:1.18.24: Na kho panāhaṃ bhante mahā-nirayaṃ upapanno,
dn24:1.18.28: abhabbo bhante acelo Pāṭika-putto taṃ vācaṃ appahāya . . .
dn24:1.18.31: Iti kho Sunakkhatta cetasā ceto paricca vidito c' eva me acelo Pāṭika-putto -- Abhabbo acelo Pāṭika-putto taṃ vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhim appaṭinissajjitvā mama sammukhī-bhāvaṃ āgantuṃ,
dn24:1.18.33: Ahaṃ taṃ vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā Samaṇassa Gotamassa sammukhī-bhāvaṃ gaccheyyan ti -- muddhā pi tassa vipateyyāti.
dn24:1.18.34: Devatā pi me etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ:
dn24:1.18.35: "Abhabbo bhante acelo Pāṭika-putto taṃ vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā Bhagavato sammukhī-bhāvaṃ āgantuṃ,
dn24:1.18.37: Ahaṃ taṃ vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā Samaṇassa Gotamassa sammukhī-bhāvaṃ gaccheyyan ti -- muddhā pi tassa vipateyyāti."
dn24:1.18.38: ‘So kho panāhaṃ Sunakkhatta Vesāliyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchā-bhattaṃ piṇḍapāta-paṭikkanto yena acelassa Pāṭika-puttassa ārāmo ten' upasaṃkamissāmi divāvihārāya.
dn24:1.18.39: Yassa dāni tvaṃ Sunakkhatta icchasi, tassa ārocehīti.' 19.
dn24:1.19.1: Atha kho 'haṃ Bhaggava pubbaṇha-samayaṃ nivāsetvā patta-cīvaraṃ ādāya Vesāliyaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ.
dn24:1.19.2: Vesāliyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchā-bhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena acelassa Pāṭika-puttassa ārāmo ten' upasaṃkamiṃ divā-vihārāya.
dn24:1.19.3: Atha kho Bhaggava Sunakkhatto Licchavi-putto taramāna-rūpo Vesāliṃ pavisitvā yena abhiññātā abhiññātā Licchavī ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā abhiññāte abhiññāte Licchavī etad avoca:
dn24:1.19.4: ‘Es' āvuso Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapāta-paṭikkanto yena acelassa Pāṭikaputtassa ārāmo ten' upasaṃkami divā-vihārāya.
dn24:1.19.5: Abhikkamath' āyasmanto abhikkamath' āyasmanto, sādhurūpānaṃ Samaṇānaṃ uttari-manussa-dhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ bhavissatīti.'
dn24:1.19.6: Atha kho Bhaggava abhiññātānaṃ abhiññātānaṃ Licchavīnaṃ etad ahosi:
dn24:1.19.7: ‘Sādhu-rūpānaṃ kira bho Samaṇānaṃ uttari-manussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ bhavissati,
dn24:1.19.9: Yena ca abhiññātā abhiññātā Brāhmaṇa-mahāsālā gahapati-necayikā nānā-titthiyā Samaṇa-Brāhmaṇā ten' upasaṃkami , upasaṃkamitvā abhiññāte abhiññāte nānātitthiye Samaṇa-Brāhmaṇe etad avoca:
dn24:1.19.10: ‘Es' āvuso Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchā-bhattaṃ piṇḍapāta-paṭikkanto yena acelassa Pāṭika-puttassa ārāmo ten' upasaṃkami divā-vihārāya.
dn24:1.19.11: Abhikkamath' āyasmanto abhikkamath' āyasmanto, sādhu-rūpānaṃ Samaṇānaṃ uttari-manussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ bhavissatīti.'
dn24:1.19.12: Atha kho Bhaggava abhiññātānaṃ abhiññātānaṃ nānātitthiyānaṃ Samaṇa-Brāhmaṇānaṃ etad ahosi:
dn24:1.19.13: ‘Sādhurūpānaṃ kira bho Samaṇānaṃ uttari-manussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ bhavissati,
dn24:1.19.15: Atha kho Bhaggava abhiññātā abhiññātā Licchavī abhiññātā abhiññātā ca Brāhmaṇa-mahāsālā gahapatinecayikā nānā-titthiyā Samaṇa-Brāhmaṇā yena acelassa Pāṭika-puttassa ārāmo ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu.
dn24:1.19.16: Sā esā Bhaggava parisā hoti aneka-satā aneka-sahassā. 20.
dn24:1.20.2: ‘Abhikkantā kira abhiññātā abhiññātā Licchavī, abhikkantā abhiññātā ca Brāhmaṇa-mahāsālā gahapati-necayikā nānātitthiyā Samaṇa-Brāhmaṇā,
dn24:1.20.3: Samaṇo pi Gotamo mayhaṃ ārāme divā-vihāraṃ nisinno ti.'
dn24:1.20.4: Sutvān' assa bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃso udapādi.
dn24:1.20.5: Atha kho Bhaggava acelo Pāṭika-putto bhīto saṃviggo lomahaṭṭha-jāto yena Tindukkhānu-paribbājakārāmo ten' upasaṃkami.
dn24:1.20.7: ‘Acelo kira Pāṭika-putto bhīto saṃviggo lomahaṭṭha-jāto yena Tindukkhānu-paribbājakārāmo ten' upasaṃkamanto ti.'
dn24:1.20.8: Atha kho Bhaggava sā parisā aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi:
dn24:1.20.9: ‘Ehi tvaṃ bho purisa, yena Tindukkhānu-paribbājakārāmo yena acelo Pāṭika-putto ten' upasaṃkama, upasaṃkamitvā acelaṃ Pāṭika-puttaṃ evaṃ vadehi --
dn24:1.20.10: Abhikkam' āvuso Pāṭika-putta, abhikkantā abhiññātā abhiññātā Licchavī, abhikkantā abhiññātā abhiññātā ca Brāhmaṇa-mahāsālā gahapati-necayikā nānā-titthiyā SamaṇaBrāhmaṇā, Samaṇo pi Gotamo āyasmato ārāme divā-vihāraṃ nisinno.
dn24:1.20.11: Bhāsitā kho pana te es' āvuso Pāṭika-putta Vesāliyaṃ parisati vācā:
dn24:1.20.12: "Samaṇo pi Gotamo ñāṇa-vādo aham pi ñāṇa-vādo,
dn24:1.20.13: ñāṇa-vādo kho pana ñāṇa-vādena arahati uttari-manussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ dassetuṃ.
dn24:1.20.14: Samaṇo Gotamo upaḍḍha-pathaṃ āgaccheyya, ahaṃ upaḍḍha-pathaṃ gaccheyyaṃ.
dn24:1.20.15: Te tattha ubho uttarimanussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ kareyyāma.
dn24:1.20.16: Ekañ ce Samaṇo Gotamo uttari-manussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ karissati. dvāhaṃ karissāmi.
dn24:1.20.17: Dve ce Samaṇo Gotamo uttari-manussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyāni karissati, cattārāhaṃ karissāmi.
dn24:1.20.18: Cattāri ce Samaṇo Gotamo uttarimanussa-dhammā iddhi- pāṭihāriyāni karissati, aṭṭhāhaṃ karissāmi.
dn24:1.20.19: Iti yāvatakaṃ yāvatakaṃ Samaṇo Gotamo uttari-manussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ karissati, taddiguṇaṃ tad- diguṇāhaṃ karissāmīti."
dn24:1.20.20: Abhikkama yeva kho āvuso Pāṭika-putta upaḍḍha -pathaṃ,
dn24:1.20.21: sabba-paṭhamaṃ yeva āgantvā Samaṇo Gotamo āyasmato ārāme divā-vihāraṃ nisinno ti.' 21.
dn24:1.21.1: ‘Evaṃ bho ti' kho Bhaggava so puriso tassā parisāya paṭissutvā yena Tindukkhānu-paribbājakārāmo yena acelo Pāṭika-putto ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā acelaṃ Pāṭika-puttaṃ etad avoca:
dn24:1.21.2: ‘Abhikkam' āvuso Pāṭika-putta, abhikkantā abhiññātā abhiññātā Licchavī . . . pe . . . Samaṇo
dn24:1.21.4: Bhāsitā kho pana te es' āvuso Pāṭika-putta Vesāliyaṃ parisati vācā:
dn24:1.21.8: Abhikkama yeva kho āvuso Pāṭika-putto upaḍḍha- pathaṃ ,
dn24:1.21.9: sabba-paṭhamaṃ yeva āgantvā Samaṇo Gotamo āyasmato ārāme divā-vihāraṃ nisinno ti.'
dn24:1.21.10: Evaṃ vutte Bhaggava acelo Pāṭika-putto ‘Āyāmi āvuso āyāmi āvuso ti' vatvā tatth' eva saṃsappati, na sakkoti āsanā pi vuṭṭhātuṃ.
dn24:1.21.11: Atha kho so Bhaggava puriso acelaṃ Pāṭika-puttaṃ etad avoca:
dn24:1.21.12: ‘Kiṃ su nāma te āvuso Pāṭika-putta? pāvaḷā su nāma te pīṭhakasmiṃ allīnā, pīṭhakaṃ su nāma te pāvaḷāsu allīnaṃ?
dn24:1.21.13: "Āyāmi āvuso āyāmi āvuso ti" vatvā tatth' eva saṃsappasi, na sakkosi āsanā pi vuṭṭhātun ti.'
dn24:1.21.14: Evam pi kho Bhaggava vuccamāno acelo Pāṭika-putto ‘Āyāmi āvuso āyāmi āvuso ti' vatvā tatth' eva saṃsappati, na sakkoti āsanā pi vuṭṭhātuṃ. 22.
dn24:1.22.1: Yadā kho so Bhaggava puriso aññāsi --
dn24:1.22.3: ‘Āyāmi āvuso āyāmi āvuso ti' vatvā tatth' eva saṃsappati, na sakkoti āsanā pi vuṭṭhātun ti, --
dn24:1.22.4: atha taṃ parisaṃ āgantvā evam ārocesi:
dn24:1.22.6: "Āyāmi āvuso āyāmi āvuso ti" vatvā tatth' eva saṃsappati, na sakkoti āsanā pi vuṭṭhātun ti.'
dn24:1.22.7: Evaṃ vutte ahaṃ Bhaggava taṃ parisaṃ etad avocaṃ:
dn24:1.22.8: ‘Abhabbo kho āvuso acelo Pāṭika-putto taṃ vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā mama sammukhī-bhāvaṃ āgantuṃ.
dn24:1.22.10: -Ahaṃ taṃ vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhim appaṭinissajjitvā Samaṇassa Gotamassa sammukhībhāvaṃ gaccheyyan ti -- muddhā pi tassa vipateyyāti.' 2. .
dn24:2.1.1: Atha kho Bhaggava aññataro Licchavi-mahāmatto uṭṭhāy' āsanā taṃ parisaṃ etad avoca:
dn24:2.1.2: ‘Tena hi bho muhuttaṃ tāva āgametha yāvāhaṃ gacchāmi,
dn24:2.1.3: app eva nāma aham pi sakkuṇeyyaṃ acelaṃ Pāṭika-puttaṃ imaṃ parisaṃ ānetun ti.'
dn24:2.1.4: Atha kho so Bhaggava Licchavi-mahāmatto yena Tindukkhānu-paribbājakārāmo yena acelo Pāṭika-putto ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā acelaṃ Pāṭika-puttaṃ etad avoca:
dn24:2.1.5: ‘Abhikkam' āvuso Pāṭika-putta, abhikkantaṃ te seyyo, abhikkantā abhiññātā abhiññātā Licchavī, abhikkantā abhiññātā abhiññātā ca Brāhmaṇa-mahāsālā gahapati-necayikā nānā-titthiyā Samaṇa-Brāhmaṇā, Samaṇo pi Gotamo āyasmato ārāme divā-vihāraṃ nisinno.
dn24:2.1.6: Bhāsitā kho pana te es' āvuso Pāṭika-putta Vesāliyaṃ parisati vācā --
dn24:2.1.7: "Samaṇo pi Gotamo ñāṇa-vādo, aham pi ñāṇa-vādo . . . pe . . .
dn24:2.1.9: Abhikkama yeva kho āvuso Pāṭika-putta upaḍḍha-pathaṃ,
dn24:2.1.10: sabba-paṭhamaṃ yeva āgantvā Samaṇo Gotamo āyasmato ārāme divāvihāraṃ nisinno.
dn24:2.1.11: Bhāsitā kho pana te esā āvuso Pāṭikaputta Samaṇena Gotamena parisati vācā:
dn24:2.1.12: "Abhabbo acelo Pāṭika-putto taṃ vācaṃ appahāya . . . pe . . .
dn24:2.1.14: Ahan taṃ vācaṃ appahāya . . . pe . . . Samaṇassa Gotamassa sammukhī-bhāvaṃ gaccheyyan ti -- muddhā pi tassa vipateyyāti."
dn24:2.1.15: Abhikkam' āvuso Pāṭika-putta, abhikkamanen' eva te jayaṃ karissāma, Samaṇassa Gotamassa parājayan ti.' 2.
dn24:2.2.1: Evaṃ vutte Bhaggava acelo Pāṭika-putto ‘Āyāmi āvuso āyāmi āvuso ti' vatvā tatth' eva saṃsappati, na sakkoti āsanā pi vuṭṭhātuṃ.
dn24:2.2.2: Atha kho so Bhaggava Licchavi-mahāmatto acelaṃ Pāṭika-puttaṃ etad avoca:
dn24:2.2.3: ‘Kiṃ su nāma te āvuso Pāṭika-putta, pāvaḷā su nāma te pīṭhakasmiṃ allīnā, pīṭhakaṃ su nāma te pāvaḷāsu allīnaṃ?
dn24:2.2.4: "Āyāmi āvuso āyāmi āvuso ti" vatvā tatth' eva saṃsappasi, na sakkosi āsanā pi vuṭṭhātun ti.'
dn24:2.2.5: Evam pi kho Bhaggava vuccamāno acelo Pāṭika-putto ‘Āyāmi āvuso āyāmi āvuso ti' vatvā tatth' eva saṃsappati, na sakkoti āsanā pi vuṭṭhātuṃ. 3.
dn24:2.3.1: Yadā kho so Bhaggava Licchavi-mahāmatto aññāsi --
dn24:2.3.2: Parābhūta-rūpo ayaṃ acelo Pāṭika-putto, ‘Āyāmi āvuso āyāmi āvuso ti' vatvā tatth' eva saṃsappati, na sakkoti āsanā pi vuṭṭhātun ti, --
dn24:2.3.3: atha taṃ parisaṃ āgantvā evam ārocesi:
dn24:2.3.4: ‘Parābhūta-rūpo so acelo Pāṭika-putto, "Āyāmi āvuso āyāmi āvuso ti" vatvā tatth' eva saṃsappati, na sakkoti āsanā pi vuṭṭhātun ti.'
dn24:2.3.5: Evaṃ vutte ahaṃ Bhaggava taṃ parisaṃ etad avocaṃ:
dn24:2.3.6: ‘Abhabbo kho āvuso acelo Pāṭika-putto taṃ vācaṃ appahāya . . .
dn24:2.3.9: Sace pi āyasmantānaṃ Licchavīnaṃ evam assa --
dn24:2.3.10: Mayaṃ acelaṃ Pāṭika-puttaṃ varattāhi bandhitvā go-yugehi āvijjheyyāmāti, -- tā varattā chijjeraṃ Pāṭika-putto vā.
dn24:2.3.11: Abhabbo pana acelo Pāṭika-putto taṃ vācaṃ appahāya . . . pe . . .
dn24:2.3.13: Ahaṃ taṃ vācaṃ appahāya . . . pe . . . muddhā pi tassa vipateyyāti.' 4.
dn24:2.4.1: Atha kho Bhaggava Jāliyo dārupattik-antevāsī uṭṭhāy' āsanā taṃ parisaṃ etad avoca:
dn24:2.4.2: ‘Tena hi bho muhuttaṃ tāva āgametha yāvāhaṃ gacchāmi,
dn24:2.4.3: app eva nāma aham pi sakkuṇeyyaṃ acelaṃ Pāṭika-puttaṃ imaṃ parisaṃ ānetun ti.'
dn24:2.4.4: Atha kho Bhaggava Jāliyo dārupattik-antevāsī yena Tindukkhānu-paribbājakārāmo yena acelo Pāṭika-putto ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā acelaṃ Pāṭika-puttaṃ etad avoca:
dn24:2.4.5: ‘Abhikkam' āvuso Pāṭika-putta, abhikkantaṃ te seyyo, abhikkantā abhiññātā ca Licchavī . . . pe . . . Samaṇo pi Gotamo āyasmato ārāme divā-vihāraṃ nisinno.
dn24:2.4.6: Bhāsitā kho pana te esā āvuso Pāṭika-putta Vesāliyaṃ parisati vācā:
dn24:2.4.9: Abhikkama yeva āvuso Pāṭika-putta upaḍḍha- pathaṃ ,
dn24:2.4.10: sabba-paṭhamaṃ yeva āgantvā Samaṇo Gotamo āyasmato ārāme divā-vihāraṃ nisinno.
dn24:2.4.11: Bhāsitā kho pana te es' āvuso Pāṭika-putta Samaṇena Gotamena parisati vācā:
dn24:2.4.12: "Abhabbo acelo Pāṭika-putto taṃ vācaṃ appahāya . . . pe . . .
dn24:2.4.14: Ahaṃ taṃ vācaṃ appahāya . . . pe . . . Samaṇassa Gotamassa sammukhī-bhāvaṃ gaccheyyan ti, -- muddhā pi tassa vipateyya."
dn24:2.4.16: Mayaṃ acelaṃ Pāṭika-puttaṃ varattāhi bandhitvā go-yugehi āvijjheyyāmāti, -- tā varattā chijjeraṃ Pāṭika-putto vā.
dn24:2.4.17: Abhabbo pana acelo Pāṭikaputto taṃ vācaṃ appahāya . . . pe . . .
dn24:2.4.19: Ahaṃ taṃ vācaṃ appahāya . . . pe . . . muddhā pi tassa vipateyyāti.
dn24:2.4.20: Abhikkam' āvuso Pāṭika-putta, abhikkamanen' eva te jayaṃ karissāma, Samaṇassa Gotamassa parājayan ti.' 5.
dn24:2.5.1: Evaṃ vutte Bhaggava acelo Pāṭika-putto ‘Āyāmi āvuso āyāmi āvuso ti' vatvā tatth' eva saṃsappati, na sakkoti āsanā pi vuṭṭhātuṃ.
dn24:2.5.2: Atha kho Bhaggava Jāliyo dārupattik-antevāsī acelaṃ Pāṭika-puttaṃ etad avoca:
dn24:2.5.3: ‘Kiṃ su nāma te āvuso Pāṭika-putto, pāvaḷā su nāma te pīṭhakasmiṃ allīnā, pīṭhakaṃ su nāma te pāvaḷāsu allīnaṃ.
dn24:2.5.4: "Āyāmi āvuso āyāmi āvuso ti" vatvā tatth' eva saṃsappasi, na sakkosi āsanā pi vuṭṭhātun ti.'
dn24:2.5.5: Evam pi kho Bhaggava vuccamāno acelo Pāṭika-putto ‘Āyāmi āvuso āyāmi āvuso ti' vatvā tatth' eva saṃsappati, na sakkoti āsanā pi vuṭṭhātuṃ. 6.
dn24:2.6.1: Yadā kho Bhaggava Jāliyo dārupattik-antevāsī aññāsi --
dn24:2.6.2: Parābhūta-rūpo ayaṃ acelo Pāṭika-putto, ‘Āyāmi āvuso āyāmi āvuso ti' vatvā tatth' eva saṃsappati, na sakkoti āsanā pi vuṭṭhātun ti -- atha naṃ etad avoca:
dn24:2.6.3: ‘Bhūta-pubbaṃ āvuso Pāṭika-putta Sīhassa miga-rañño etad ahosi:
dn24:2.6.4: "Yan nūnāhaṃ aññataraṃ vana-saṇḍaṃ nissāya āsayaṃ kappeyyaṃ,
dn24:2.6.5: tatr' āsayaṃ kappetvā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ āsayā nikkhameyyaṃ, āsayā nikkhamitvā vijambheyyaṃ, vijambhitvā samantā catuddisā anuvilokeyyaṃ, samantā catuddisā anuviloketvā tikkhattuṃ sīha-nādaṃ nadeyyaṃ, tikkhattuṃ sīha-nādaṃ naditvā go-carāya pakkameyyaṃ;
dn24:2.6.6: so varaṃ varaṃ miga-saṃghe vadhitvā mudu-maṃsāni mudu-maṃsāni bhakkhayitvā tam eva āsayaṃ ajjhupeyyan ti."
dn24:2.6.7: ‘Atha kho so āvuso Sīho miga-rājā aññataraṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ nissāya āsayaṃ kappesi,
dn24:2.6.8: tatr' āsayaṃ kappetvā sāyaṇha-samayaṃ āsayā nikkhami, āsayā nikkhamitvā vijambhi, vijambhitvā samantā catuddisā anuvilokesi, samantā catuddisā anuviloketvā tikkhattuṃ sīha-nādaṃ nadi, tikkhattuṃ sīha-nādaṃ naditvā go-carāya pakkami,
dn24:2.6.9: so varaṃ varaṃ miga-saṃghe vadhitvā mudu-maṃsāni mudu-maṃsāni bhakkhayitvā tam eva āsayaṃ ajjhupesi. 7.
dn24:2.6.10: ‘Tass' eva kho āvuso Pāṭika-putta Sīhassa migarañño vighāse saṃvaddho Jara-sigālo ditto c' eva balavā ca.
dn24:2.6.11: Atha kho āvuso tassa Jara-sigālassa etad ahosi:
dn24:2.6.13: Yan nūnāham pi aññataraṃ vana-saṇḍaṃ nissāya āsayaṃ kappeyyaṃ,
dn24:2.6.14: tatr' āsayaṃ kappetvā sāyaṇha-samayaṃ āsayā nikkhameyyaṃ, āsayā nikkhamitvā vijambheyyaṃ, vijambhitvā samantā catuddisā anuvilokeyyaṃ, samantā catuddisā anuviloketvā tikkhattuṃ sīha-nādaṃ nadeyyaṃ, tikkhattuṃ sīha-nādaṃ naditvā go-carāya pakkameyyaṃ;
dn24:2.6.15: so varaṃ varaṃ miga-saṃghe vadhitvā mudu-maṃsāni mudu-maṃsāni bhakkhayitvā tam eva āsayaṃ ajjhupeyyan ti."
dn24:2.7.1: ‘Atha kho so āvuso Jara-sigālo aññataraṃ vana-saṇḍaṃ nissāya āsayaṃ kappesi,
dn24:2.7.2: tatr' āsayaṃ kappetvā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ āsayā nikkhami, āsayā nikkhamitvā vijambhi, vijambhitvā samantā catuddisā anuviloketi, samantā catuddisā anuviloketvā "Tikkhattuṃ sīha-nādaṃ nadissāmīti" sigālakaṃ yeva anadi, bheraṇḍakaṃ yeva anadi, "Ke ca chave sigāle, ke pana sīha-nāde ti?"
dn24:2.7.3: ‘Evam eva kho tvaṃ āvuso Pāṭika-putta Sugatāpadānesu jīvamāno Sugatātirittāni bhuñjamāno Tathāgate arahante Sammā-Sambuddhe āsādetabbaṃ maññasi --
dn24:2.7.4: Ke ca chave Pāṭika-putte, kā ca Tathāgatānaṃ arahantānaṃ SammāSambuddhānaṃ āsādanā ti?' 8.
dn24:2.8.1: Yato kho Bhaggava Jāliyo dārupattik-antevāsī iminā opammena n' eva asakkhi acelaṃ Pāṭika-puttaṃ tamhā āsanā cāvetuṃ,
dn24:2.8.6: "Ke ca chave sigāle, ke pana sīha-nāde ti?"
dn24:2.8.7: ‘Evam eva kho tvaṃ āvuso Pāṭika-putta Sugatāpadānesu jīvamāno Sugatātirittāni bhuñjamāno Tathāgate arahante Sammā-Sambuddhe āsādetabbaṃ maññasi --
dn24:2.8.8: Ke ca chave Pāṭika-putte, kā ca Tathāgatānaṃ arahantānaṃ SammāSambuddhānaṃ āsādanā ti?' 9.
dn24:2.9.1: Yato kho Bhaggava Jāliyo dārupattik-antevāsī iminā pi opammena n' eva asakkhi acelaṃ Pāṭika-puttaṃ tamhā āsanā cāvetuṃ,
dn24:2.9.8: "Ke ca chave sigāle ke pana sīha-nāde ti?"
dn24:2.9.9: ‘Evam eva kho tvaṃ āvuso Pāṭika-putta Sugatāpadānesu jīvamāno Sugatātirittāni bhuñjamāno Tathāgate arahante Sammā-Sambuddhe āsādetabbaṃ maññasi --
dn24:2.9.10: Ke ca chave Pāṭika-putte, kā ca Tathāgatānam arahantānaṃ SammāSambuddhānaṃ āsādanā ti?' 10.
dn24:2.10.1: Yato kho Bhaggava Jāliyo dārupattik-antevāsī iminā pi opammena n' eva asakkhi acelaṃ Pāṭika-puttaṃ tamhā āsanā cāvetuṃ,
dn24:2.10.8: "Ke ca chave sigāle, ke pana sīha-nāde ti?"
dn24:2.10.9: ‘Evam eva kho tvaṃ āvuso Pāṭika-putta Sugatāpadānesu jīvamāno Sugatātirittāni bhuñjamāno Tathāgate arahante Sammā-Sambuddhe āsādetabbaṃ maññasi --
dn24:2.10.10: Ke ca chave Pāṭika-putte, kā ca Tathāgatānaṃ arahantānaṃ SammāSambuddhānaṃ āsādanā ti?' 11.
dn24:2.11.1: Yato kho Bhaggava Jāliyo dārupattik-antevāsī iminā pi opammena n' eva asakkhi acelaṃ Pāṭika-puttaṃ tamhā āsanā cāvetuṃ,
dn24:2.11.2: atha taṃ parisaṃ āgantvā evam ārocesi:
dn24:2.11.3: ‘Parābhūta-rūpo bho acelo Pāṭika-putto, "Āyāmi āvuso āyāmi āvuso ti" vatvā tatth' eva saṃsappati, na sakkoti āsanā pi vuṭṭhātun ti.' 12.
dn24:2.12.1: Evaṃ vutte ahaṃ Bhaggava taṃ parisaṃ etad avocaṃ:
dn24:2.12.2: ‘Abhabbo kho āvuso acelo Pāṭika-putto taṃ vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā mama sammukhī-bhāvaṃ āgantuṃ.
dn24:2.12.4: Ahaṃ taṃ vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā Samaṇassa Gotamassa sammukhībhāvaṃ gaccheyyan ti, -- muddhā pi tassa vipateyya.
dn24:2.12.5: Sace p' āyasmantānaṃ Licchavīnaṃ evam assa --
dn24:2.12.6: Mayaṃ acelaṃ Pāṭika-puttaṃ varattāhi bandhitvā go-yugehi āvijjheyyāmāti -- tā varattā chijjeraṃ Pāṭika-putto vā.
dn24:2.12.7: Abhabbo pana acelo Pāṭika-putto taṃ vācaṃ appahāya . . . pe . . . mama sammukhī-bhāvaṃ āgantuṃ.
dn24:2.12.8: Sace pi 'ssa evam assa -- Ahaṃ taṃ vācaṃ appahāya . . . pe . . . Samaṇassa Gotamassa sammukhī-bhāvaṃ gaccheyyan ti, -- muddhā pi tassa vipateyyāti.' 13.
dn24:2.13.1: Atha kho 'haṃ Bhaggava taṃ parisaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesiṃ samādapesiṃ samuttejesiṃ sampahaṃsesiṃ, taṃ parisaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā mahā-bandhanā mokkhaṃ karitvā, caturāsīti-pāṇa-sahassāni mahā-viduggā uddharitvā, tejo-dhātuṃ samāpajjitvā, satta-tālaṃ vehāsaṃ abbhuggantvā, aññaṃ satta-tālaṃ pi acciṃ abhinimminitvā jāletvā dhūpāyitvā Mahāvane kūṭāgāra-sālāyaṃ paccuṭṭhāsiṃ.
dn24:2.13.2: Atha kho Bhaggava Sunakkhatto Licchavi-putto yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantam nisinnaṃ kho ahaṃ Bhaggava Sunakkhattaṃ Licchavi-puttaṃ etad avocaṃ:
dn24:2.13.4: Yath' evāhaṃ te acelaṃ Pāṭika-puttaṃ ārabbha vyākāsiṃ, tath' eva taṃ vipākaṃ no aññathā ti?'
dn24:2.13.5: ‘Yath' eva me bhante Bhagavā acelaṃ Pāṭika-puttaṃ ārabbha vyākāsi, tath' eva taṃ vipākaṃ no aññathā ti.'
dn24:2.13.7: Yadi evaṃ sante kataṃ vā hoti uttari-manussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ akataṃ vā ti?'
dn24:2.13.8: ‘Addhā kho bhante evaṃ sante kataṃ hoti uttarimanussa-dhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ no akatan ti.'
dn24:2.13.9: ‘Evam pi kho maṃ tvaṃ mogha-purisa uttari-manussadhammā iddhi-pāṭihāriyaṃ karontam evaṃ vadesi:
dn24:2.13.10: "Na hi pana me bhante Bhagavā uttari-manussa-dhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ karotīti."
dn24:2.13.11: Passa mogha-purisa yāvañ ca te idaṃ aparaddhan ti.'
dn24:2.13.12: Evam pi kho Bhaggava Sunakkhatto Licchavi-putto mayā vuccamāno apakkam' eva imasmā dhamma-vinayā yathā taṃ āpāyiko nerayiko. 14.
dn24:2.14.2: tañ ca pajānāmi, tato ca uttaritaraṃ pajānāmi, tañ ca pajānanaṃ na parāmasāmi, aparāmasato me paccattaṃ yeva nibbuti viditā yad abhijānaṃ Tathāgato no anayaṃ āpajjati.
dn24:2.14.3: Santi Bhaggava eke Samaṇa-Brāhmaṇā Issara-kuttaṃ Brahmakuttaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññāpenti.
dn24:2.14.5: ‘Saccaṃ kira tumhe āyasmanto Issara-kuttaṃ Brahma-kuttaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññāpethāti?'
dn24:2.14.6: Te ca me evaṃ puṭṭhā -- ‘Āmo ti' paṭijānanti.
dn24:2.14.8: ‘Kathaṃ vihitakaṃ pana tumhe āyasmanto Issara-kuttaṃ Brahma-kuttaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññāpethāti?'
dn24:2.14.9: Te mayā puṭṭhā na sampāyanti. Asampāyantā mam aññe va paṭipucchanti.
dn24:2.14.11: ‘Hoti kho so āvuso samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena ayaṃ loko saṃvaṭṭati,
dn24:2.14.12: saṃvaṭṭamāne loke yebhuyyena sattā Ābhassara-saṃvaṭṭanikā honti.
dn24:2.14.13: Te tattha honti mano-mayā pīti-bhakkhā sayam-pabhā antalikkha-carā subha-ṭṭhāyino, ciraṃ dīgham addhānaṃ tiṭṭhanti.
dn24:2.15.1: Hoti kho so āvuso samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena ayaṃ loko vivaṭṭati,
dn24:2.15.3: Atha aññataro satto āyu-kkhayā vā puñña-kkhayā vā Ābhassarakāyā cavitvā suññaṃ Brahma-vimānaṃ upapajjati.
dn24:2.15.4: So tattha hoti mano-mayo pīti bhakkho sayam-pabho antalikkhacaro subha-ṭṭhāyī, ciraṃ dīgham addhānaṃ tiṭṭhati.
dn24:2.16.1: Tassa tattha ekakassa dīgha-rattaṃ nibbusitattā anabhirati paritassanā uppajjati:
dn24:2.16.2: "aho vata aññe pi sattā itthattaṃ āgaccheyyun ti."
dn24:2.16.3: Atha aññe pi sattā āyu-kkhayā vā puñña-kkhayā vā Ābhassara-kāyā cavitvā suññaṃ Brahmavimānaṃ upapajjanti tassa sattassa sahavyataṃ.
dn24:2.16.4: Te pi tattha honti mano-mayā pīti-bhakkhā sayam-pabhā antalikkha-carā subha-ṭṭhāyino, ciraṃ dīgham addhānaṃ tiṭṭhanti. 16.
dn24:2.17.1: ‘Tatr' āvuso yo so satto paṭhamaṃ upapanno, tassa evaṃ hoti:
dn24:2.17.2: "Aham asmi Brahmā Mahā-brahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthu -daso vasavatti issaro kattā nimmātā seṭṭho sañjitā vasī pitā bhūta-bhavyānaṃ. Mayā ime sattā nimmitā.
dn24:2.17.5: Aho vata aññe pi sattā itthattaṃ āgaccheyyun ti.
dn24:2.17.6: Iti mamañ ca mano-paṇidhi, ime ca sattā itthattaṃ āgatā ti."
dn24:2.17.7: Ye pi te sattā pacchā upapannā, tesaṃ pi evaṃ hoti --
dn24:2.17.8: "Ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ Brahmā Mahābrahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthu -daso vasavatti issaro kattā nimmātā seṭṭho sañjitā vasī pitā bhūtabhavyānaṃ.
dn24:2.17.11: Imaṃ hi mayaṃ addasāma idha paṭhamaṃ upapannaṃ, mayaṃ pan' amhā pacchā upapannā ti." 17.
dn24:2.17.12: ‘Tatr' āvuso yo so satto paṭhamaṃ upapanno, so dīghāyukataro ca hoti vaṇṇavantataro ca mahesakkhataro ca.
dn24:2.17.13: Ye pana te sattā pacchā upapannā, te appāyukatarā ca honti dubbaṇṇatarā ca appesakkhatarā ca.
dn24:2.17.14: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ āvuso vijjati yaṃ aññataro satto tamhā kāyā cavitvā itthattaṃ āgacchati.
dn24:2.17.15: Itthattaṃ āgato samāno agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati.
dn24:2.17.16: Agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito samāno ātappam anvāya padhānam anvāya anuyogam anvāya appamādam anvāya sammā-manasikāram anvāya tathārūpaṃ ceto-samādhiṃ phusati yathā samāhite citte taṃ pubbe nivāsaṃ anussarati, tato paraṃ nānussarati.
dn24:2.17.18: "Yo kho so bhavaṃ Brahmā Mahā-brahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññad-atthu-daso vasavatti issaro kattā nimmātā seṭṭho sañjitā vasī pitā bhūtabhavyānaṃ yena mayaṃ bhotā Brahmunā nimmitā, so nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāma-dhammo sassati-samaṃ tath' eva ṭhassati.
dn24:2.17.19: Ye pana mayaṃ ahumha tena bhotā Brahmunā nimmitā, te mayaṃ aniccā addhuvā appāyukā cavana-dhammā itthattaṃ āgatā ti."
dn24:2.17.20: Evaṃ vihitakaṃ bho tumhe āyasmanto Issara-kuttaṃ Brahma-kuttaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññapethāti.'
dn24:2.17.22: ‘Evaṃ kho no āvuso Gotama sutaṃ yath' ev' āyasmā Gotamo āhāti.'
dn24:2.17.24: pe . . . yad abhijānaṃ Tathāgato no anayaṃ āpajjati. 18.
dn24:2.18.1: Santi Bhaggava eke Samaṇa-Brāhmaṇā khiddāpadūsikaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññapenti.
dn24:2.18.3: ‘Saccaṃ kira tumhe āyasmanto khiḍḍā-padūsikaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññapethāti?'
dn24:2.18.4: Te ca me evaṃ puṭṭhā -- ‘Āmo ti' paṭijānanti.
dn24:2.18.6: ‘Kathaṃ vihitakam pana tumhe āyasmanto khiḍḍā-padūsikaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññapethāti?'
dn24:2.18.7: Te mayā puṭṭhā na sampāyanti. Asampāyantā mam' aññe va paṭipucchanti.
dn24:2.18.9: ‘Sant' āvuso khiḍḍā-padūsikā nāma devā. Te ativelaṃ hassa-khiḍḍā-rati-dhamma-samāpannā viharanti. Tesaṃ ativelaṃ hassa-khiḍḍā-rati-dhamma-samāpannānaṃ viharataṃ sati sammussati, satiyā sammosā te devā tamhā kāyā cavanti.
dn24:2.18.10: Ṭhānam kho pan' etaṃ āvuso vijjati, yaṃ aññataro satto tamhā kāyā cavitvā itthattaṃ āgacchati,
dn24:2.18.11: itthattaṃ āgato samāno agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati.
dn24:2.18.12: Agārasmā anagāriyaṃ samāno pabbajito samāno ātappam anvāya . . . pe . . . tathārūpaṃ ceto-samādhiṃ phusati yathā samāhite citte taṃ pubbe-nivāsaṃ anussarati, tato paraṃ nānussarati.
dn24:2.18.14: "Ye kho te bhonto devā na khiḍḍā-padūsikā te na ativelaṃ hassa-khiḍḍā-ratidhamma-samāpannā viharanti. Tesaṃ nātivelaṃ hassakhiḍḍā-rati-dhamma-samāpannānaṃ viharataṃ sati na sammussati, satiyā asammosā te devā tamhā kāyā na cavanti,
dn24:2.18.15: niccā dhuvā sassatā avipariṇāma-dhammā sassatisamaṃ tath' eva ṭhassanti.
dn24:2.18.16: Ye pana mayaṃ ahumha khiḍḍā-padūsikā te mayaṃ ativelaṃ hassa-khiḍḍārati-dhamma-samāpannā viharimha. Tesaṃ no ativelaṃ. hassa-khiḍḍā-rati-dhamma-samāpannānaṃ viharataṃ sati sammussati, satiyā sammosā eva mayaṃ tamhā kāyā cutā
dn24:2.18.17: aniccā addhuvā asassatā appāyukā cavana-dhammā itthattaṃ āgatā ti."
dn24:2.18.18: Evaṃ vihitakaṃ bho tumhe āyasmanto khiḍḍā-padūsikaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññapethāti?'
dn24:2.18.20: ‘Evaṃ kho no āvuso Gotama sutaṃ yath' ev' āyasmā Gotamo āhāti.'
dn24:2.18.22: yad abhijānaṃ Tathāgato no anayaṃ āpajjati. 19.
dn24:2.19.1: Santi Bhaggava eke Samaṇa-Brāhmaṇā mano-padūsikaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññapenti.
dn24:2.19.3: ‘Saccaṃ kira tumhe āyasmanto mano-padūsikaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññapethāti?'
dn24:2.19.4: Te ca me evaṃ puṭṭhā -- ‘Āmo ti' paṭijānanti.
dn24:2.19.6: ‘Kathaṃ vihitakaṃ pana tumhe āyasmanto mano-padūsikaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññapethāti?'
dn24:2.19.7: Te mayā puṭṭhā na sampāyanti. Asampāyantā mamañ ñeva paṭipucchanti.
dn24:2.19.9: ‘Sant' āvuso mano-padūsikā nāma devā. Te ativelaṃ aññamaññaṃ upanijjhāyanti. Te ativelaṃ aññamaññaṃ upanijjhāyantā aññamaññamhi cittāni padūsenti. Te aññamaññaṃ paduṭṭha-cittā kilanta-kāyā kilanta-cittā. Te devā tamhā kāyā cavanti.
dn24:2.19.10: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ āvuso vijjati yaṃ aññataro satto tamhā kāyā cavitvā itthattaṃ āgacchati,
dn24:2.19.11: itthattaṃ āgato samāno agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati.
dn24:2.19.12: Agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito samāno ātappam anvāya . . . pe . . . tathārūpaṃ ceto-samādhiṃ phusati yathā samāhite citte taṃ pubbe-nivāsaṃ anussarati, tato paraṃ nānussarati.
dn24:2.19.14: "Ye kho te bhonto devā na mano-padūsikā te nātivelaṃ aññamaññaṃ upanijjhāyanti. Te nātivelaṃ aññamaññaṃ upanijjhāyantā aññamaññamhi cittāni nappadūsenti. Te aññamaññaṃ appaduṭṭha-cittā akilanta-kāyā akilanta-cittā. Te devā tamhā kāyā na cavanti,
dn24:2.19.15: niccā dhuvā sassatā avipariṇāmadhammā sassati-samaṃ tath' eva ṭhassanti.
dn24:2.19.16: Ye pana mayaṃ ahumha mano-padūsikā te mayaṃ ativelaṃ añña maññaṃ upanijjhāyimha. Te mayaṃ ativelaṃ aññamaññaṃ upanijjhāyantā aññamaññamhi cittāni padūsimha. Te mayaṃ aññamaññaṃ paduṭṭha-cittā kilanta-kāyā kilantacittā eva, mayaṃ tamhā kāyā cutā
dn24:2.19.17: aniccā addhuvā appāyukā cavana-dhammā itthattaṃ āgatā ti."
dn24:2.19.18: Evaṃ vihitakaṃ bho tumhe āyasmanto mano-padūsikaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññapethāti.'
dn24:2.19.20: ‘Evaṃ kho no āvuso Gotama sutaṃ yath' ev' āyasmā Gotamo āhāti.'
dn24:2.19.22: yad abhijānaṃ Tathāgato no anayaṃ āpajjati. 20.
dn24:2.20.1: Santi Bhaggava eke Samaṇa-Brāhmaṇā adhicca-samuppannaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññapenti.
dn24:2.20.3: ‘Saccaṃ kira tumhe āyasmanto adhicca-samuppannaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññapethāti?'
dn24:2.20.4: Te ca me evaṃ puṭṭhā -- ‘Āmo ti' paṭijānanti.
dn24:2.20.6: ‘Kathaṃ vihitakaṃ pana tumhe āyasmanto adhicca-samuppannaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññapethāti?'
dn24:2.20.7: Te mayā puṭṭhā na sampāyanti. Asampāyantā mamañ ñeva paṭipucchanti.
dn24:2.20.10: saññuppādā ca pana te devā tamhā kāyā cavanti.
dn24:2.20.11: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ āvuso vijjati, yaṃ aññataro satto tamhā kāyā cavitvā itthattaṃ āgacchati,
dn24:2.20.12: itthattaṃ āgato samāno agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati.
dn24:2.20.13: Agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito samāno ātappam anvāya . . . pe . . . tathārūpaṃ ceto-samādhiṃ phusati yathā samāhite citte taṃ saññuppādaṃ anussarati, tato paraṃ nānussarati.
dn24:2.20.17: Ahaṃ hi pubbe nāhosim, so 'mhi etarahi ahutvā sattattāya pariṇato ti.'
dn24:2.20.18: Evaṃ vihitakaṃ bho tumhe āyasmanto adhicca-samuppannaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññapethāti.'
dn24:2.20.20: ‘Evaṃ kho no āvuso Gotama sutaṃ yath' ev' āyasmā Gotamo āhāti.'
dn24:2.20.21: Aggaññaṃ cāhaṃ Bhaggava jānāmi, tañ ca pajānāmi, tato ca uttaritaraṃ pajānāmi tañ ca pajānanaṃ na parāmasāmi, aparāmasato ca me paccattaṃ yeva nibbuti viditā
dn24:2.20.22: yad abhijānaṃ Tathāgato no anayaṃ āpajjati. 21.
dn24:2.21.1: Evaṃ-vādiṃ kho maṃ Bhaggava evam akkhāyiṃ eke Samaṇa-Brāhmaṇā asatā tucchā musā abhūtena abbhācikkhanti:
dn24:2.21.4: Yasmiṃ samaye subhaṃ vimokhaṃ upasampajja viharati, sabbaṃ tasmiṃ samaye asubhan t' eva sañjānātīti.'
dn24:2.21.5: Na kho panāhaṃ Bhaggava evaṃ vadāmi:
dn24:2.21.6: ‘Yasmiṃ samaye subhaṃ vimokhaṃ upasampajja viharati, sabbaṃ tasmiṃ samaye asubhan t' eva sañjānātīti.'
dn24:2.21.7: Evañ ca kho ahaṃ Bhaggava vadāmi:
dn24:2.21.8: ‘Yasmiṃ samaye subhaṃ vimokhaṃ upasampajja viharati, subhan t' eva tasmiṃ samaye sañjānātīti.'
dn24:2.21.9: Te ca bhante viparītā ye Bhagavantaṃ viparītato dahanti bhikkhavo ca,
dn24:2.21.10: ‘Evaṃ pasanno ahaṃ Bhagavati, pahoti me Bhagavā tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ yathā ahaṃ subhaṃ vimokhaṃ upasampajja vihareyyan ti.'
dn24:2.21.11: ‘Dukkaraṃ kho evaṃ Bhaggava tayā añña-diṭṭhikena añña-khantikena añña-rucikena aññatr' āyogena aññatr' ācariyakena subhaṃ vimokhaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ.
dn24:2.21.12: Iṅgha tvaṃ Bhaggava, yo ca te ayaṃ mayi pasādo, tam eva tvaṃ sādhukaṃ anurakkhāti.'
dn24:2.21.13: ‘Sac' etaṃ bhante mayā dukkaraṃ añña-diṭṭhikena añña-khantikena añña-rucikena aññatr' āyogena aññatr' ācariyakena subhaṃ vimokhaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ,
dn24:2.21.14: yo ca me ayaṃ bhante Bhagavati pasādo, tam evāhaṃ sādhukaṃ anurakkhissāmīti.'
dn24:2.21.16: Attamano Bhaggava-gotto paribbājako Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
